daas-irab:1-1.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿هُوَ﴾ the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar (predicate); the clause is the khabar of هو, and the clause «هو..» is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:2-2.t: ﴿اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿لَمْ يَلِدْ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by lam, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلَمْ يُولَدْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a passive imperfect verb in the jussive by lam, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to what precedes it.

daas-irab:4-4.t: ﴿وَلَمْ يَكُنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by lam. ﴿لَهُ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) كفوا. ﴿كُفُواً﴾ the fronted khabar (predicate) of يكن. ﴿أَحَدٌ﴾ its postponed noun. The clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to what precedes it.
